mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5%) signals weak labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 8.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals aggressive monetary policy response to economic weakness, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when both conditions are met (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% in 3 months) signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST is above 550 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is above 90 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 500) signal weak consumer demand and economic stagnation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST is below 500 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production (INDPRO < 90) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO is below 90 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
